description:
Remail is a modern, open-source mobile client specifically designed for the Resend.com email platform. Inspired by the familiar Gmail interface, it brings an intuitive email experience to your fingertips.
Key Features:
• Gmail-inspired Interface: Navigate your emails with ease using a clean, familiar, and responsive design.
• Complete Email Management: Effortlessly view your Resend.com email history.
• Powerful Composer: Compose emails with support for attachments and multiple recipient fields.
• Secure & Private: Your Resend API key is stored locally and securely.
How to Use:
• Get your API Key: Log in to your Resend.com dashboard and generate a new API key with full permissions.
• Authentication: Open Remail and enter your API key and default address to securely sync your account.
• Start Sending: Use the compose button to send your first email through Resend's infrastructure.
• Manage: Use the inbox and composer like a streamlined Gmail-style client for Resend.
